schema.name: USG Neutral Building Specification
schema.purpose: Software-neutral description of Building 002 after one generation run and three designer reviews. Supersedes v0.1, which is kept unchanged for comparison.

evidence_classes.exact: Dimensioned in the sketch or stated by the designer. Binding.
evidence_classes.derived: Computed from exact values without adding intent. Binding.
evidence_classes.user_accepted: Proposed by AI (proportion or production default), reviewed and accepted by the designer on a model view. Binding for the concept phase; reopens if a source or factual gate contradicts it. Proposal: docs/proposals/evidence-class-mapping.md.
evidence_classes.observed: Presence or topology visible in the sketch; geometry not reliable.
evidence_classes.approximate: Proportionally inferred; may be realized only under a labeled policy.
evidence_classes.ambiguous: Materially different readings remain; ask the designer.

schema.core_rule: Dimensions override proportion. Proportion fills gaps. Designer confirmation resolves ambiguity. A '~' on the source forces approximate. A conflict between source and confirmation is raised, never resolved silently.

usg_state.resolution_note: Partial resolution reconstructed from a designer's sketch; S00-S05, S07, S09-S10, S13 and S15 were not run. Not a feasibility, regulatory or performance validation.
usg_state.human_acceptance_required_before: promotion of approximate or user_accepted geometry beyond concept phase

coordinate_system.origin: top-left corner of the lower box as drawn in plan
coordinate_system.note: Local drawing coordinates, not geographic. Left-handed in plan as drawn; a target must mirror y (Y_target = -y) to obtain a right-handed frame.

levels.source: 3,0 m on perspective, confirmed as level height
6,0 m on perspective, confirmed as top of upper roof

volumes.footprint_source: 10 x 7 m estimated from plan column markers; confirmed by designer 2026-10-26

columns.note: Lower columns sit inside the solid corner piers of the lower facade frame. Upper columns run from ground to the roof underside; tops are host-derived, not level-bound.

roofs.form_source: designer correction 2026-10-26; v0.1 read perspective convergence as slope

overhang.edges_note: Sketch dimensions the overhang at the right (east) end only. Concept model applied it on all four edges; not yet confirmed.

overhang.source: designer correction 2026-10-26: lower level has no overhang

facades.faces_note: Perspective shows the S and W faces; N and E assumed the same.
facades.composition_source: perspective: solid corner piers, head band below the slab edge, double jamb lines; accepted by designer

glazing.module_source: sketch note '~1,5 m segments'; designer confirmed 1.5 m

facades.composition_note: Perspective shows vertical divisions under the upper roof; whether the upper box also has a solid frame is open.

guards.path: lower-box edge outside the upper box, 100 mm inset
guards.typology_source: perspective: three continuous horizontal rails, sparse posts, no balusters; accepted by designer
guards.note: Heights accepted as concept values only; code compliance is not assessed (S09/S17).

stairs.location: along the top (north) edge of the lower box, inside
stairs.realization_note: Concept model: 2 flights x 8 risers (187.5 mm), treads 250 mm, landing 1000 mm. Riser/tread values are a production choice, not USG intent.

internal_core_or_wall.position: stair side wall plus a leg to the inner upper column

annotations.note: v0.1 bound this to the lower roof.
